EP25001.line: And we are underway! Chelsea get the match started. The roar from the Parisian ultras is deafening.
Enzo clips a ball towards Reece James, but Nuno Mendes is up quickly to head it back into the Chelsea half.
Chelsea's tactical shape is apparent. As Colwill carries the ball forward, Cucurella drifts inside to create a numerical advantage in the middle.
First sign of danger! Vitinha slides a pass into the channel for Mbappé... but the flag is up. Just offside. A warning shot fired.
Cole Palmer gets his first touches, drifting inside. He tries to nutmeg Ugarte, but the Uruguayan stands his ground.
Dembélé whips in a dangerous cross towards the near post. Colwill does brilliantly to get in front of his man and head it clear.
Chelsea are living dangerously. Vitinha nicks the ball off Caicedo! It breaks for Zaïre-Emery on the edge of the box! He shoots! Blocked by Fofana!
Dembélé's corner finds Marquinhos, who rises highest! His powerful header is straight at Petrovic, who holds on securely.
A moment of respite for Chelsea. Jackson draws a foul from Beraldo. Enzo takes it quickly with a 50-yard diagonal to Reece James.
James drives forward and beats Mendes, but Vitinha has tracked back an incredible distance to slide in and block the cross for a corner.
Chelsea work a short corner. Mudryk receives the ball inside the box but his first-time shot is wild, high and wide. A wasted opportunity.
PSG are patient now, moving the ball across the backline, trying to draw Chelsea's press out.
Magic from Dembélé! He jinks past Cucurella and cuts it back low across the six-yard box. Colwill just gets a vital touch to divert it away from Kolo Muani.
Chelsea break! Nkunku feeds Jackson, who cuts inside and curls a shot towards the far corner... it's just wide of the post! Donnarumma was scrambling.
Hakimi flies down the right and delivers a cross. It falls to Mbappé at the back post, but he slices his volley. A rare miscue.
Petrovic rolls it to Enzo, who clips a perfectly-weighted pass over the top for Mudryk's run, but Hakimi matches him for pace.
Mbappé drops deep. He lays it off to Vitinha and spins in behind, but Fofana reads it superbly and intercepts.
GOAL FOR PSG! A lightning counter-attack! Vitinha slides an inch-perfect through ball to Mbappé, who is one-on-one and curls it with devastating precision into the far bottom corner.
Chelsea look shell-shocked. That is the danger you face here. One slip in concentration, and you are punished.
YELLOW CARD! Moisés Caicedo goes into the book for cynically pulling back Dembélé to prevent a counter-attack.
PSG are buzzing. Zaïre-Emery glides past two challenges and switches play to Mendes, but Reece James is alert to the danger.
Chelsea manage to string a sequence of passes together, trying to draw the sting out of the game and regain their composure.
Good play from Chelsea! Jackson's shot is blocked by Marquinhos. The rebound falls to Mudryk, but his effort is comfortable for Donnarumma.
Hakimi gets to the byline again and crosses. Kolo Muani leaps and heads it down... but Petrovic is there to smother it!
A lull in the action as Nuno Mendes receives some treatment. A chance for both teams to take on instructions.
Mendes is back on his feet and we are back underway. Chelsea have possession, trying to build from the back again.
Enzo shows his class. Under pressure, he spins away from Vitinha and pings a 60-yard pass to the chest of Reece James.
James drives at Mendes and finds Nkunku, but Beraldo is sharp and steps in to intercept.

CHANCE FOR CHELSEA! Oh, they should be level! Palmer slides a defense-splitting pass to Jackson. He only has Donnarumma to beat... but the keeper makes himself huge and saves with his outstretched leg!
From the corner, the ball is cleared to Caicedo. He strikes it on the half-volley from 25 yards... it flies a yard over the bar.

LL25001.line: El Clásico is underway in Madrid! This match is scheduled for tomorrow but we're simulating it.
Bellingham and Gavi in an early midfield tussle.
GOAL! Real Madrid! Vinícius Jr. breaks free and slots it past the keeper!

BL25001.line: Kick-off in Munich for this completed match.
And that's the full-time whistle! Bayern won 3-0.
